title: Listo Finalists
lede: A two-pairing template showing every field the format supports. The numbers here are illustrative, not a scored shortlist — copy this file and author your own against listo-build/references/axis-rubrics.md. The pre-rebuild 11-pairing set is archived beside this file as finalists-v1.json; it predates the ten-axis model and will not validate.
cards_note: Every card carries its own sheet's numbers. Scores come from listo-build/references/scoring-model.md: tempo is damage plus control, capped by Actions; the rest is resilience, duration and utility.

splits.a: Profane Soul Blood Hunter 14 (INT) / Wizard 6 (Evocation), Wizard 1 first

bombard-fervor.tagline: A Blood Hunter that carries its own area damage off the same Intelligence it already maximises, beside a heavy-armour Cleric who maximises Fireball twice a short rest.
bombard-fervor.shape: Covers tempo and durability outright. Rescue sits entirely on the support — the carry scores 0 on it in every act — and Skills never rises above 3 on either half, because Blood Hunter's list is four Intelligence skills and Intelligence is the dump on the support.
bombard-fervor.damage: Owns the crowd fight from Act II, when Fireball and the maximised burst both land. The priority column leans on Brand of the Sapping Scar rather than raw single-target, which is why the boss term holds up as enemy save DCs climb.

volley-vow.tagline: At-will full-damage area attacks beside an aura that lifts both bodies' saves — the pair that answers crowds with damage rather than with locks.
volley-vow.shape: The aura is the point: it is a pair booster, so it raises the carry's saves as well as its own before the Personal minimum. Control is thin on all four cells, and neither half brings Rescue above 2.
volley-vow.damage: Volley is full weapon damage to every target, no save and no resource, twice a round with Lone Wolf's second Action. The boss column never doubles, so this pair wins crowds and merely keeps pace against a single target.

cards.title: Tempo
cards.body: Damage and control both remove enemy action points. Both are split crowd-versus-boss, blended by act, then capped by Actions — a capability you cannot afford to deploy delivers nothing.

cards.title: The rest
cards.body: Resilience, duration and utility, weighted. Rescue sits in resilience: its action cost is already priced by where a chassis lands on the rubric ladder.

cards.title: Saves are derived
cards.body: Index 8 is always null. Author the proficient-ability set and any boosters; aura-of-protection is pair-scoped and raises both bodies before the Personal minimum.
